own_solution.law: Energy conservation: v_esc = sqrt(2GM/R) = R*sqrt(8*pi*G*rho/3), so v_esc scales as R*sqrt(rho); scale from Earth's 11.19 km/s

notes: Scaling: 11.19*(3390/6371)*sqrt(3.93/5.51) = 11.19*0.53210*0.84454 = 5.0286 km/s. Direct with G = 6.674e-11 gives 5.025 km/s; the Earth data are self-consistent only to ~0.07% (computed Earth value 11.18 vs stated 11.19), within the 3-4 figure precision. With a 310 km same-density layer on the planet R = 3700 km: 5.0286*3700/3390 = 5.488 km/s. Moon layer is D because the pull of any other body is ignored. Probe mass cancels from (1/2)mv^2 = GMm/R. Variants state the same numbers (310 km, 2270 kg); T39C4 and TC598 are numeral-free.
